title: Add support track init messages
body:
As a user a would like to send miscellaneous initialization MIDI messages to a track and to have control over their order, including interlacing of CC and program change MIDI messages.

A track can configure in its format an `init` property that takes an array of `MidiMessagePlugin`s. The following plugin types are supported:

* `CcMidiMessagePlugin` can send one or _more_ CC MIDI messages.
* `ProgramChangeMidiMessagePlugin` can send a Program Change MIDI message.
* `RawMidiMessagePlugin` can send on or more MIDI messages expressed as raw bytes. These can be expressed as an array of numbers, each between 0 and 255.
* (optional) plugin(s) for selecting a MIDI mode.

A `MidiMessagePlugin` encapsulates logic to generate a collection of `MidiMessage`s or a collection of `ScMidiMessage`.
